svg.title: Stores & calculations
svg.desc: Describe a change: Thrown ball: kinetic → gravitational; air resistance also warms surroundings. Brakes: kinetic → thermal. Kettle: electrical transfer → water’s thermal store. In collisions, kinetic energy may decrease while total energy is conserved. Conservation: Closed system: no net change in total energy. Include surroundings receiving transfers. Dissipation spreads energy into less useful stores. “Wasted” does not mean destroyed. Motion & height: Eₖ = ½mv²; Eₚ = mgΔh. Use given g. A 2 kg object at 3 m/s has 9 J. Rearrange: v = √(2Eₖ/m). Double speed → four times kinetic energy. Springs: Eₑ = ½ke² within proportional limit. e = stretched length − original length, in metres. k = 200 N/m, e = 0.050 m → Eₑ = 0.25 J. Square the converted extension. Power is a rate: P = E/t = W/t; E = Pt. 1,800 J in 30 s → 60 W. 1 kW = 1,000 W; 1 kJ = 1,000 J. Powerful does not automatically mean efficient. Efficiency: Useful output / total input, for energy or power. No unit; at most 1 or 100%. 350 J useful from 500 J → 70%; 150 J dissipated. Lubrication reduces friction and unwanted heating.
